name: LTX-2.3
description: This is not my model. Don't ask me questions. I don't know the answers. Go to the official LTX-2.3 HuggingFace repo for answers. I've only uploaded the model here as a way to tag the videos I generate with it. It will most likely be taken down once the official owners or CivitAI upload their own version, so be warned. The following is the original README as of time of publishing. LTX-2.3 is a DiT-based audio-video foundation model designed to generate synchronized video and audio within a single model. It brings together the core building blocks of modern video generation, with open weights and a focus on practical, local execution.
